subject: Don't know how to add geom_bar

messages.author: 67d9969f93ac5614
messages.subject: Don't know how to add geom_bar
parts:
I encountered a bizarre error while making a ggplot:

> gg <- ggplot(plotDf, aes(x = xVar, y = yVar)) 
> gg <- gg + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + xlab('')
Error: Don't know how to add geom_bar(stat = "identity") to a plot

Traceback shed light on the matter:

> traceback()
3: stop("Don't know how to add ", objectname, " to a plot", call. = FALSE)
2: add_ggplot(e1, e2, e2name)
1: `+.gg`(ggplot(plotDf, aes(x = xVar, y = yVar)), geom_bar())

Then I realized that ggplot itself uses 'gg' as a variable name. In fact, it is even one of the classes in ggplot2.

After replacing gg by pp, it worked!

> pp <- ggplot(plotDf, aes(x = xVar, y = yVar)) 
> pp <- pp + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + xlab('')

Just wanted to share this with others who encounter this problem in future!


Adi
